summary_zh:
前往玄武岩峽谷，有兩個地方，這裡標示的地點是「西岸」，西岸這裡開車進來，有休息區，步行到峽谷約 5 分鐘，如果你是到「東岸」，則要步行約 1 小時才能抵達。

此處是玄武岩峽谷 Grund 側的主要入口，從停車場步行約5分鐘即可抵達階梯及觀景平台，但不能由此進入峽谷河床。若想近距離接觸玄武岩柱，需改走Klaustursel東側步道。923號公路部分為碎石路，冬季須先確認路況。

這裡停車場需付費，有簡餐餐廳，也有免費的廁所。
summary_en: Travel to the basalt canyon has two access points; this listing shows the west side entrance. Drive to the west side, where a parking lot and a rest area are available (parking is paid, restroom is free). From the parking lot, walk about 5 minutes to reach the stairs and viewpoint; however, you cannot enter the canyon riverbed from here. To get close to the basalt columns, take the Klaustursel trail on the east side. Note that part of Route 923 is a gravel road, and you should check road conditions in winter. If you choose the east side entrance, expect a 1‑hour walk to the canyon. Recommended stay time is around 60 minutes.
